pricing.note: Every price on this page — `price`, `fares.price_from` / `price_to`, `seat_categories[].price_from` — is ONE SEAT (one ticket). Upstream prices this product per passenger and ignores the party size, so nothing here scales with it. For the 2 passengers you searched, each offer also carries `price_party` = that offer's cheapest fare x 2. Quote it as «от»: it assumes all 2 travel on the SAME fare row, which holds only while that row still seats them (`seats_left >= 2`, visible in `view='full'`); a mixed-class party pays more.
